helpful: The provisioned petition and BIO full texts were the single most useful input for a grant-moment merits cell — the stay-history and circuit-split framing, and the BIO's standing/vehicle objections, came straight from them with no retrieval needed.
The statpack merits section's per-Term disturbed table with the excluded column made the pooled baseline a two-minute computation with clear quotability rules.
gaps: fedcourts query --citation cost 1329 GETs (~348 MB) to return zero rows; a cheap pre-check (or a note in --help that citation coverage is 161/590k) before the ranged scan would save most of that egress.

A merits cell would benefit from the companion/linked dockets' state (here 25-1019 and 25-1022 are VIDED throughout) being provisioned or at least identified in context.json — whether the companion petition was also granted bears on the scope of the judgment being forecast.
notes: Forward merits cell at moment: grant; merits briefs not yet filed, so the provisioned cert-stage record plus the statpack carried the whole forecast. One background-slow corpus query (~2 min) was the only retrieval.
